cell-secretory-path.alt: A simplified animal cell with the nucleus, nucleolus and nuclear pores, rough ER with ribosomes, smooth ER, the Golgi complex, vesicles, a lysosome, a mitochondrion and free ribosomes. Numbered arrows trace a protein for export: built on the rough ER, carried in a vesicle to the Golgi, modified and packaged, then released at the cell membrane.
